entity.summary: Kazakhstan-based regulated digital-asset exchange operator providing exchange and OTC execution alongside custody and crypto-fiat services.
entity.notes: The current first-party site identifies Delta DA Ltd. as a regulated exchange operator and presents exchange-based and OTC execution services. AFSA's current public register lists its Digital Asset Trading Facility licence AFSA-G-LA-2021-0019 as active through 2027-01-31. The site's statement that the company was established in 2021 is not converted into an exact platform launch date.

evidence.title: DeltaDA regulated digital asset exchange
evidence.notes: Current first-party site identifies Delta DA Ltd. as an operating regulated crypto exchange and describes exchange-based execution, OTC trading, custody, and crypto-fiat services.

evidence.title: Delta DA Ltd. AFSA Digital Asset Trading Facility licence
evidence.notes: Official AFSA public register lists Delta DA Ltd. licence AFSA-G-LA-2021-0019 as active for Operating a Digital Asset Trading Facility, with the current extension running through 2027-01-31.
